name: Eos
based: Hiwatt DR103, plus the Comfortably Numb solo tones
intro: Eos got a full makeover and two packs mixed into one head. Underneath is the Hiwatt DR103: CHANNEL picks Normal, Brilliant or Linked (both inputs jumped, the classic Hiwatt trick), and Volume steps through the real captures on each one. DRIVE adds the pack's pedal captures. The ivory SOLO selector is the second pack: turn it away from OFF and it clicks through seven Comfortably Numb solo tones (Studio, DSOT, Pulse, RTN, Gdansk, Pompeii, Rome), which take over until you turn it back to OFF.
notes: New look: a thick ivory faceplate with rounded edges, gold trim rails, round black lacquer transformer cans with gold bands, gold tube collars and feet, a gold sunrise emblem and gold channel buttons.
Hiwatt (13 files, amp only): Normal goes Vol 3 → 5 → 8 → cranked, Brilliant goes clean → Vol 3 → Vol 8, Linked goes edgy → crunch → full. Each channel keeps its own Volume.
DRIVE (3 LEDs): I is an Archer Klon pushing the amp, II is the Klon as a drive, III is a TS808 stacked into the Klon.
The solo tones (7 files) were captured from a HiTone DG-50 with the cab included, so the plugin should bypass its cab while SOLO is on.
